note: Gamepad cursor feel on the overhead grid. Stick past deadzone moves one cell, then repeats after firstRepeatSeconds every repeatSeconds (faster when pushed fully).
heightNote: Placeholder box heights: floors x 10.5 ft for types with floors, else U.h, else 14 ft (browser drawing, builder-v30.html line 1363, 1437: H=(U[t].fl?fl*10.5:(U[t].h||14))). Roads, lots, parks (not isB) draw flat.

toolWheel.note: Controller tool picking, any tool within 3 presses: 1) a bumper opens a wheel (ToolWheelPrev = left bumper opens wheel 1, ToolWheelNext = right bumper opens wheel 2; pressed again while open they flip wheels), 2) a slot button picks a group page, 3) a slot button picks the tool. Groups with more than 'slots' tools split into pages labelled by pageLabel, each its own wheel slot. Pages fill wheels in dock order (Data/ui/tool-groups.json), 'slots' per wheel, so up to 2 x slots pages stay within 3 presses. ToolWheelBack (View/Back button, Escape) steps back. Mouse is unchanged: dock tab, then tool (2 clicks). Lower 'slots' to 7 and drop ToolSlotEast to keep B as back.
toolWheel.slotBindings: ToolSlotUp/Right/Down/Left = d-pad; ToolSlotNorth = Y/triangle, ToolSlotEast = B/circle, ToolSlotSouth = A/cross, ToolSlotWest = X/square (gamepad only, active while the wheel is open)
